craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Standing-state; rising-joy-exults; iti-bridge + ellipsis kept per UNC. Rejected: (a) filling ellipsis → killed by UNC. (b) expanding compound → killed unexpanded. Read aloud: WHO — SOME-bliss-POW-ered-ONE … EX-ults.

lines: Who — some bliss-powered one — standing in own state —
l4.sanskrit_cite: yaḥ kaścit ānandabalaḥ sa svarūpapadasthitaḥ | iti yasya samullāsollāsitodayaśālinaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Who stands bliss-powered? → Bliss-powered established; rising joy thus.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
